# BTC Pavao

Practical Bitcoin Core and Bitcoin Standard education focused on clear reasoning, recoverable self-custody, and maintainable systems.

- [Homepage](https://btcpavao.com/)
- [Bitcoin Core guides](https://btcpavao.com/en/bitcoin-core/)
- [Start here with Bitcoin Core](https://btcpavao.com/en/bitcoin-core/start-here/)
- [Bitcoin Core wallet setup, backup and recovery](https://btcpavao.com/en/bitcoin-core/wallet-setup-backup-recovery/)
- [Bitcoin self-custody curriculum](https://btcpavao.com/en/bitcoin-core/self-custody/)
- [Writing](https://btcpavao.com/en/writing/)
- [Support this work](https://btcpavao.com/en/support/)

Croatian versions are available under corresponding `/hr/` routes when published.
